critique_067_bound.extrapolation_flaw: Linearly interpolates across a wide 50-token gap (V=50 to V=100). The local volume-outcome response partial(Y)/partial(V) is non-linear and step-like; dropping 1 critical token can destroy a proof step entirely.
critique_067_bound.truncation_confound: In static supports, natural responses were 150-250 tokens and were severely truncated by the hard 25-token/edge cap. Learned controller naturally emitted shorter responses (~24 tokens/edge), avoiding truncation damage.
critique_067_bound.synthetic_provenance_issue: P4 was executed on simple synthetic template problems ('Bob has X apples...'), where short answers suffice, unlike real multi-hop benchmarks.
critique_067_bound.p5_authentic_evidence: When evaluated on real GSM8K under exact volume matching in P5, learned top-2 routing chose S_1 100% of the time. The isolated routing effect Delta_routing = Cell C - Cell A = 0.00 pp (p = 1.000). The observed accuracy gain was entirely driven by adaptive early stopping (+2.00 pp) saving 69.6% tokens.
critique_067_bound.verdict: REMOVED. The <= 0.023 pp residual claim lacks rigorous empirical and theoretical justification. Topological routing does not explain the margin; early stopping and prompt conciseness drive efficiency.

task7.centralized_dominance: Full-Union achieves 71.33% EM at only 405k tokens (31.5% fewer tokens than NoComm, and 68.5% fewer tokens than Dense). Multi-agent communication is only justified when privacy, context-length bounds, or distributed systems prevent centralization.
task7.sparse_pareto_front: Among distributed sparse topologies, In-Star achieves 55.33% EM under voting (and 60.15% under fallback) with only 1 recipient update per question, outperforming Random (33.33%) and Complementary (43.33%).

task9.conversational_decay_round3: -2.00 pp drop from Round 1 to Round 3
task9.quality_cost_frontier: Halting immediately upon unanimous agreement or SPRT S > log 19 strictly dominates fixed depth, saving 69.6% tokens while improving accuracy by +2.00 pp.

primary_contrast_P5_routing.verdict: Learned top-2 routing converges identically to Static Out-Star S1 on GSM8K.

secondary_contrast_P5_stopping.verdict: Non-inferior accuracy (+2.00 pp) with massive 69.6% communication reduction.

sink1_vs_fallback_in_star.verdict: Monotonically non-negative gain (0 introduced errors, 5 recovered errors).

support_collapse_findings.GSM8K: Support collapse to Out-Star 0->1, 0->2 in 100% of instances. Controller acts as a source broadcaster rather than a dynamic re-router.
support_collapse_findings.HotpotQA: High entropy regime (2.584 bits, within 0.001 bits of uniform random). Under low initial confidence, controller fails to prune, activating all channels.

role_confounding.agent_0: Confounded with analytical role prompt, array index 0, and highest standalone benchmark accuracy.
role_confounding.role_permutation_bound: Permuting roles across agent indices demonstrates that broadcast authority follows the agent with the highest standalone accuracy, not graph geometry per se.
role_confounding.scope_limitation: Claims of general topological optimality must be strictly qualified: in 3-agent homogeneous systems, topology collapses to source selection.
